description: This file defines the Properties class responsible for reading and processing document properties (both standard and custom) from XML data within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for parsing XML, handling property types, and setting properties on the Spreadsheet object.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: Provides functionality for reading and processing document properties from XML within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Properties object with a Spreadsheet instance.

methods.name: readProperties
methods.description: Reads standard and custom properties from an XML element and updates the Spreadsheet's properties accordingly.

methods.name: readStandardProperties
methods.description: Parses and processes standard document properties from the XML.

methods.name: readCustomProperties
methods.description: Parses and processes custom document properties from the XML.

methods.name: processStandardProperty
methods.description: Sets a standard property on the DocumentProperties object based on property name and value.

methods.name: processCustomProperty
methods.description: Processes and sets a custom property with type handling based on XML attributes.

methods.name: hex2str
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal code point to a UTF-8 character.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes of a SimpleXMLElement for a specific namespace, providing a fallback empty XML if null.
